wallets_user_stock_unique.name: wallets_user_stock_unique
wallets_user_stock_unique.where: "wallets"."deleted_at" is null and "wallets"."stock_symbol" is not null

wallets_stock_fields.name: wallets_stock_fields
wallets_stock_fields.value: ("wallets"."type" = 'stock') = ("wallets"."stock_symbol" is not null and "wallets"."lots" is not null) and ("wallets"."lots" is null or "wallets"."lots" >= 0)
